summary.text: Christopher Prosch is the Republican candidate for Iowa State Senate District 1 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Catelin Drey.
He is the founder and owner of Felix Strategies, a media consulting firm in Sioux City.

paragraphs.text: Christopher Prosch founded and owns Felix Strategies, a media consulting firm in Sioux City, according to Ballotpedia, which also lists him as an usher at Cornerstone church, a tutor for college students and a Trail Life mentor.
His campaign website says he worked in politics for various state parties and candidates before building a media management company that works with podcasters and radio and TV networks.
Prosch was the Republican candidate in the August 26, 2025 special general election for the same seat, which Drey won with 55.2 percent to his 44.7 percent, according to Ballotpedia.
He advanced from the 2026 Republican primary with 100 percent of the vote.
His campaign website says he would work to eliminate the state income tax, give parents the ultimate say in their children's education, and protect unborn life.
